items.title: Explain why we add rectangle areas when splitting, but subtract the cut-out area when using the whole rectangle
question: Explain why we add rectangle areas when splitting, but subtract the cut-out area when using the whole rectangle.
answer: Splitting covers the shape exactly once. The enclosing rectangle includes an extra cut-out, so remove its area. Give area in cm².
